title: NLP Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build software, mathematics, statistics and machine-learning foundations first, then specialise in language models, information retrieval, NLP evaluation and production language systems.

facts.Current degree: B.Tech / B.E. — CSE - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and progressing through 2030.

rows.text: Python, Git, Linux and programming fundamentals
3 Python programs + 50 programming problems + GitHub repo with README
Linear algebra, calculus, probability, statistics, NumPy
Implement 10 numerical/statistical operations and explain their assumptions
DSA, SQL, pandas, text processing and data cleaning
NLP fundamentals: tokenisation, stemming, TF-IDF, n-grams, classification
Build 3 NLP classifiers and compare precision/recall/F1
Neural NLP, embeddings, attention and transformers
Fine-tune a transformer on a documented dataset and publish evaluation results
LLM applications, RAG, information retrieval, evaluation and internship/open source
Hugging Face Learn · Microsoft AI Engineer training
Build a RAG system with retrieval metrics, answer evaluation and failure analysis
NLP production systems, APIs, Docker, MLOps, monitoring and cloud
Containerised NLP service + automated tests/deployment + latency measurement
Portfolio, system design, research reading and interviews
3 NLP projects + architecture diagrams + 5 mock interviews

blocks.text: Use the additional year for a research-heavy NLP project, publication-quality experiments, a major industry project, open-source contributions or a research internship. The BCA-specific 3-year/4-year credit figures do not apply to this B.Tech/B.E. roadmap.

rows.text: Search, ranking, embeddings, vector databases, evaluation
LLMs, dialogue systems, tool calling, evaluation
Docker, APIs, CI/CD, monitoring, model serving

blocks.text: Move from individual NLP models to language-system architecture: retrieval, model routing, evaluation, safety, multilingual support, latency and cost optimisation, privacy and production reliability. Keep learning new model architectures while maintaining strong information-retrieval, statistics and software-engineering fundamentals.

blocks.label: 12+ years
blocks.text: Technical leadership, research leadership or AI platform leadership
These are planning ranges, not guaranteed promotion timelines.

Long-term NLP engineering increasingly involves designing complete language systems rather than only training models. Build expertise in retrieval, evaluation, multilingual systems, model efficiency, safety, privacy, infrastructure and human-AI interaction while retaining strong software and statistical foundations.
